import json,os
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
di,do_=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
for r,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(di,do_)):
    if a!=b: print(r,[ (j,a[j],b[j]) for j in range(len(a)) if a[j]!=b[j]])
# rule: find rows that are almost-complete lines of a non-bg color; extend
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    from collections import Counter
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        c=Counter(row)
        # background = most common
        bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
        others=[v for v,n in c.items() if v!=bg]
        if len(others)==1:
            v=others[0]
            n=c[v]
            if 0<n<w:  # incomplete line
                # extend to full width
                for j in range(w):
                    if row[j]==bg: g[i][j]=1
    return g
print(transform(di)==do_)
out=transform(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))
